title: Helka_Lab_02_9041
text:
Measures
The following scales were used:
The Social Interaction Anxiety Scale, with a Cronbach’s alpha of 0.9,
The Experiences in Close Relationships Scale, with an alpha of 0.94,
The Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale had an alpha of 0.85.

title: Helka_Lab_02_9041
text:
Data Analysis Strategy
Items marked with a leading minus sign in the answer key (e.g., -sa_5) were reverse-keyed before scoring.All items included: Items 5, 9, and 11 from the Social Interaction Anxitey Scale and Items 2, 5, 6, 8, and 9 in the Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale.
